Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
Have you made any arrangements with American publishers about my [Scripture Readings](../books.html#87)? I think I might perhaps do so, but I should like first to know whether you have any views.
[Miss Sewell](../persons.html#1301) is very anxious to know when the [selections](../books.html#82) are to come.
I suspect you are from home.

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
